privacy.metaDescription: RADIANZ privacy policy: data collected through the website and contact form, purposes, retention periods, and GDPR rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: RADIANZ is committed to protecting the personal data of visitors to radianz.tech and people who contact us through the demo request form.

dataController.title: Data controller
dataController.body: The data controller is RADIANZ. For any question about your data, contact us through the form on the Contact page.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
dataCollected.body: We collect the information you submit in the contact form: first name, last name, email address, company, sites to qualify per month, and message. Technical data (IP address, browser, pages viewed) may also be recorded for security and analytics.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.body: Your data is used to respond to demo requests, support commercial follow-up, improve the website, and keep it secure. We do not sell your data to third parties.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Contact requests are kept for the duration of the commercial relationship, then archived or deleted within three years of the last interaction, unless a longer period is required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: To exercise your rights or ask a question about this policy, use the form on the Contact page and specify the subject of your request.
